G2977.def:
**λάθρᾳ** (Att..; in Hom., -ρῃ, Rec. -ρα),
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for ‎סֵתֶר ;]
**secretly**: [[Mat.1.19; 2.7|Mat.1:19 2:7]], [[Mrk.5.33|Mrk.5:33]] (WH, mg.), [[Jhn.11.28|Jhn.11:28]], [[Act.16.37|Act.16:37]].†
(AS)

G2962.def:
**κύριος**, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον),
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for בַּעַל ,אָדוֹן, etc. ;]
**having power** (κῦρος) or **authority**; as subst., ὁ κ., **lord, master**;
1. **in general**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.9.38; 20.8|Mat.9:38 20:8]], [[Mrk.12.9; 13.35|Mrk.12:9 13:35]], [[Luk.19.33|Luk.19:33]]; τ. σαββάτου, [[Mat.12.8|Mat.12:8]], [[Mrk.2.28|Mrk.2:28]], [[Luk.6.5|Luk.6:5]]; with genitive of person(s), δούλου, etc., [[Mat.10.24|Mat.10:24]], [[Luk.14.21|Luk.14:21]], [[Act.16.16|Act.16:16]], al.; absol, opposite to οἱ δοῦλοι, [[Eph.6.5|Eph.6:5]], 9 al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., _LAE_, 161), [[Act.25.26|Act.25:26]] θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, [[1Co.8.5|1Co.8:5]] of a husband, [[1Pe.3.6|1Pe.3:6]] in voc, as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., [[Mat.13.27; 16.22; 27.63|Mat.13:27 16:22 27:63]], [[Mrk.7.28|Mrk.7:28]], [[Luk.5.12|Luk.5:12]], [[Jhn.4.11|Jhn.4:11]], [[Act.9.5|Act.9:5]], al.
2. **As a divine title **(frequently in π.; Deiss., _LAE_, 353 ff.); in NT,
(a) **of God**: ὁ κ., [[Mat.5.33|Mat.5:33]], [[Mrk.5.19|Mrk.5:19]], [[Luk.1.6|Luk.1:6]], [[Act.7.33|Act.7:33]], [[Heb.8.2|Heb.8:2]], [[Jas.4.15|Jas.4:15]], al.; anarth. (Bl., §46, 6), [[Mat.21.9|Mat.21:9]], [[Mrk.13.20|Mrk.13:20]], [[Luk.1.17|Luk.1:17]], [[Heb.7.21|Heb.7:21]], [[1Pe.1.25|1Pe.1:25]], al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, [[Mat.11.25|Mat.11:25]] τ. κυριευόντων, [[1Ti.6.15|1Ti.6:15]] κ. ὁ θεός, [[Mat.4.7, 10|Mat.4:7, 10]] al.; id. before παντοκράτωρ, [[Rev.4.8|Rev.4:8]] κ. σαβαώθ, [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]] (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, [[Mat.1.20; 2.13|Mat.1:20 2:13]], [[Luk.1.11|Luk.1:11]], al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, [[Luk.4.18|Luk.4:18]], [[Act.8.39|Act.8:39]];
(b) **of the Christ**: [[Mat.21.3|Mat.21:3]], [[Mrk.11.3|Mrk.11:3]], [[Luk.1.43; 20.44|Luk.1:43 20:44]], al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, _Words_, 330), [[Act.10.36|Act.10:36]], [[Rom.14.8|Rom.14:8]], [[1Co.7.22|1Co.7:22]], [[Eph.4.5|Eph.4:5]], al.; ὁ κ. μου, [[Jhn.20.28|Jhn.20:28]] ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, [[Act.1.21|Act.1:21]], [[1Co.11.23|1Co.11:23]], al.; id. before Χριστός, [[Eph.1.2|Eph.1:2]], al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, [[1Ti.1.14|1Ti.1:14]], [[Heb.7.14|Heb.7:14]], al.; id. before Ἰησοῦς, [[1Th.3.11|1Th.3:11]], [[Heb.13.20|Heb.13:20]], al.; Χριστός, [[Rom.16.18|Rom.16:18]] Ἰ Χ., [[1Co.1.2|1Co.1:2]], [[1Th.1.3|1Th.1:3]], al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), [[Rom.1.4|Rom.1:4]], [[Col.2.6|Col.2:6]], [[Eph.3.11|Eph.3:11]], al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, [[2Pe.3.2|2Pe.3:2]] id. before Ἰ. Χ., ib. 18; anarth., [[1Co.7.22, 25|1Co.7:22, 25]] [[Jas.5.4|Jas.5:4]], al.; κ. κυρίων, [[Rev.19.16|Rev.19:16]] with prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., [[Col.3.24|Col.3:24]], al.
_SYN:_ see: δεσπότης. (AS)

G2992.def:
**λαός**, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX very frequently for עַם, [[Gen.14.16|Gen.14:16]], al.; occasionally for לְאֹם ( [[Gen.25.23|Gen.25:23]], al.), etc. ;]
a word rarely found in Att. prose;
1. **the people** at large (Hom., al.), esp. of people assembled: [[Mat.27.25|Mat.27:25]], [[Luk.1.21; 3.15|Luk.1:21 3:15]] al.; pl. (Hom., al., π.; see MM, xvi), [[Act.4.27|Act.4:27]]
2. **a people**, those of the same race and language (Pind., Æsch., al.: in LXX, [[Gen.26.11|Gen.26:11]], [[Exo.9.16|Exo.9:16]], al.): joined with γλῶσσα, φυλή, ἔθνος, [[Rev.5.9; 7.9; 11.9|Rev.5:9 7:9 11:9]], al.; pl., [[Luk.2.31|Luk.2:31]], [[Rom.15.11|Rom.15:11]]; esp. as almost always in LXX, of Israel, [[Mat.4.23|Mat.4:23]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]], [[Luk.2.10|Luk.2:10]], [[Jhn.11.50|Jhn.11:50]], [[Heb.2.17|Heb.2:17]], al.; opposite to τ. ἔθνη, [[Act.26.17, 23|Act.26:17, 23]] [[Rom.15.10|Rom.15:10]]; πρεσβύτεροι (πρῶτοι, etc.) τοῦ λ., [[Mat.21.23|Mat.21:23]], [[Luk.19.17|Luk.19:17]], [[Act.4.8|Act.4:8]], al.; ὁ λ. μου (αὐτοῦ, τ. θεοῦ), [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]], [[Luk.1.68|Luk.1:68]], [[Heb.11.25|Heb.11:25]], al.; of the people disting. from the rulers and priests ( I [[Est.1.10|Est.1:10]], [[Jdt.8.9|Jdth.8:9]], al.), [[Mat.26.5|Mat.26:5]], [[Luk.20.19|Luk.20:19]], [[Heb.5.3|Heb.5:3]], al.; of Christians, as the people of God, [[Act.15.14|Act.15:14]], [[Rom.9.25, 26|Rom.9:25, 26]] [[Heb.4.9|Heb.4:9]]; περιούσιος, [[Tit.2.14|Tit.2:14]] εἰς περιποίησιν, [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX).
_SYN._: see: δῆμος. (AS)

G2928.def:
**Κρύπτω **
[in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;]
**to hide, conceal**: with accusative, [[Mat.13.44; 25.18|Mat.13:44 25:18]]; before ἐν, [[Mat.25.25|Mat.25:25]] (pass., [[Mat.13.44|Mat.13:44]], [[Col.3.3|Col.3:3]]); pass., [[Mat.5.14|Mat.5:14]], [[Heb.11.23|Heb.11:23]], [[1Ti.5.25|1Ti.5:25]], [[Rev.2.17|Rev.2:17]]; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, _Pr._, 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν [[Jhn.8.59|Jhn.8:59]] before εἰς, [[Luk.13.21|Luk.13:21]], [[Rev.6.15|Rev.6:15]]; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), [[Rev.6.16|Rev.6:16]] pass., [[Jhn.12.36|Jhn.12:36]], (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaphorical: [[Mat.11.25; 13.35|Mat.11:25 13:35]], [[Luk.11.52|Luk.11:52]], WH, mg., [[Luk.18.34; 19.42|Luk.18:34 19:42]], [[Jhn.19.38|Jhn.19:38]] (cf.ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).†
(AS)

G2923.def:
**κριτής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;]
**a judge**: [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]], [[Luk.12.14, 58; 18.2|Luk.12:14, 58 18:2]]; τ. ἀδικίας, [[Luk.18.6|Luk.18:6]] with gem of thing(s) (obj.), [[Act.18.15|Act.18:15]], [[Jas.4.11|Jas.4:11]]; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, [[Jas.2.4|Jas.2:4]] of a Roman procurator, [[Act.24.10|Act.24:10]] of God, [[Heb.12.23|Heb.12:23]], [[Jas.4.12|Jas.4:12]]; Christ, [[Act.10.42|Act.10:42]], [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]], [[Jas.5.9|Jas.5:9]]; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, [[Mat.12.27|Mat.12:27]], [[Luk.11.19|Luk.11:19]]; in the OT sense ([[Jdg.2.16|Jdg.2:16]], [[Rut.1.1|Rut.1:1]], al), of a ruler in Israel, [[Act.13.20|Act.13:20]]†
_SYN._: δικάστης, q.v (AS)

G2919.def:
**κρίνω**,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;]
1. **to separate, select, choose** (cl.; in LXX: [[2Ma.13.15|2Ma.13:15]]).
2. **to approve, esteem**: [[Rom.14.5|Rom.14:5]]
3. **to be of opinion, judge, think**: [[Luk.7.43|Luk.7:43]], [[1Co.11.13|1Co.11:13]]; before τοῦτο ὅτι, [[2Co.5.14|2Co.5:14]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.16.15|Act.16:15]] with accusative and pred., [[Act.13.46; 26.8|Act.13:46 26:8]].
4. **to decide, determine, decree**: with accusative, [[Act.16.4|Act.16:4]], [[Rom.14.13|Rom.14:13]], [[1Co.7.37|1Co.7:37]], [[2Co.2.1|2Co.2:1]]; with inf. (Field, _Notes_, 167), [[Act.20.16; 25.25|Act.20:16 25:25]], [[1Co.2.2; 5.3|1Co.2:2 5:3]], [[Tit.3.12|Tit.3:12]] (cf. [[1Ma.11.33|1Ma.11:33]], [[Wis.8.9|Wis.8:9]], al.); with accusative and inf., [[Act.21.25; 27.1|Act.21:25 27:1]].
5. **to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment**: absol., [[Jhn.8.16, 26|Jhn.8:16, 26]]; before κατά, with accusative, [[Jhn.7.24; 8.15|Jhn.7:24 8:15]]; κρίσιν κ., [[Jhn.7.24|Jhn.7:24]] τ. δίκαιον, [[Luk.12.57|Luk.12:57]] (Deiss., _LAE_, 118); in forensic sense, [[Jhn.18.31|Jhn.18:31]], [[Act.23.3|Act.23:3]], al.; pass., [[Rom.3.4|Rom.3:4]] (LXX); of God's judgment, [[Jhn.5.30; 8.50|Jhn.5:30 8:50]], [[Rom.2.16; 3.6|Rom.2:16 3:6]], [[2Ti.4.1|2Ti.4:1]], [[1Pe.4.5|1Pe.4:5]], al.
6. = κατακρίνω, **to condemn** (cl.): [[Act.13.27|Act.13:27]] of God's judgment, [[Jhn.3.18; 5.22; 12.47, 48|Jhn.3:18 5:22 12:47, 48]], [[Act.7.7|Act.7:7]], [[Rom.2.12|Rom.2:12]], [[1Co.11.32|1Co.11:32]], [[Heb.10.30|Heb.10:30]]" (LXX), [[Jas.5.9|Jas.5:9]], [[Rev.19.2|Rev.19:2]], al.
7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), **to rule, govern** ( [[4Ki.15.5|4Ki.15:5]], [[Psa.2.10|Psa.2:10]], al.): [[Mat.19.28|Mat.19:28]], [[Luk.22.30|Luk.22:30]], [[1Co.6.3|1Co.6:3]].
8. **to bring to trial** (cl.); mid., **to go to law**: with dative of person(s), [[Mat.5.40|Mat.5:40]] before μετά, with genitive of person(s) (of the opponent), ἐπί, with genitive (of the judge), [[1Co.6.1|1Co.6:1]], 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)).
_SYN._: see: δικάστης. (AS)

G2983.def:
**λαμβάνω**,
[in LXX chiefly for לקח, also for אחז ,לכד ,נשׂא, etc. ;]
1. **to take, lay hold of**: absol., [[Mat.26.26|Mat.26:26]], [[Mrk.14.22|Mrk.14:22]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.5.40; 26.52|Mat.5:40 26:52]], al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.21.35|Mat.21:35]], [[Mrk.12.3|Mrk.12:3]], al.; pleonastic λαβών (M, _Pr._, 230; Bl., §74, 2), [[Mat.13.31; 14.19|Mat.13:31 14:19]], al.; so also indic., [[Mrk.7.27|Mrk.7:27]], [[Jhn.19.1, 40|Jhn.19:1, 40]] [[Rev.8.5|Rev.8:5]], al.; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), ἀφορμήν, [[Rom.7.8, 11|Rom.7:8, 11]]; ὑδόδειγμα, [[Jas.5.10|Jas.5:10]] id. with accusative of person(s), φόβος, [[Luk.7.16|Luk.7:16]] πνεῦμα, [[Luk.9.39|Luk.9:39]] πειρασμός, [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]] aoristic pf. (M, _Pr._, 145, 238; BL, §59, 4), [[Rev.5.7; 8.5|Rev.5:7 8:5]], al.
2. **to receive**: absol., opposite to αἰτεῖν, [[Mat.7.8|Mat.7:8]], al.; διδόναι, [[Mat.10.8|Mat.10:8]], [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.27.6|Mat.27:6]], [[Mrk.10.3|Mrk.10:3]]o, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.6.21; 13.20; 19.27|Jhn.6:21 13:20 19:27]], [[2Jn.10|2Jo.10]]; ῥαπίσμασιν (a vulgarism; Bl., §38, 3), [[Mrk.14.65|Mrk.14:65]] metaphorically, τ. λόγον, [[Mat.13.20|Mat.13:20]], [[Mrk.4.16|Mrk.4:16]]; τ. μαρτυρίαν, [[Jhn.3.11|Jhn.3:11]] τ. ῥήματα, [[Jhn.12.48|Jhn.12:48]] πρόσωπον (Heb. נָשָׂא פָּנִים, Dalman, _Words_, 30), [[Luk.20.21|Luk.20:21]], [[Gal.2.6|Gal.2:6]]; ζωὴν αἰώνιον (Dalman, _op. cit._, 124f.), [[Mrk.10.30|Mrk.10:30]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, συν-αντι- (-μαι), ἀπο-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, συν-περι-, ὑπο-λαμβάνω).
(AS)

G2927.def:
**κρυπτός**, -ή, -όν
(κρύπτω) [in LXX for אָטַם, מִסְתָּר, etc. ;]
**hidden, secret**: [[Mat.10.26|Mat.10:26]], [[Mrk.4.22|Mrk.4:22]], [[Luk.8.17; 12.2|Luk.8:17 12:2]]; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, [[1Pe.3.4|1Pe.3:4]] neut., ἐν τῷ κ., [[Mat.6.4|Mat.6:4]], 6; ἐν κ., [[Jhn.7.4, 10; 18.20|Jhn.7:4, 10 18:20]]; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, [[Rom.2.29|Rom.2:29]] pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, [[1Co.4.5|1Co.4:5]] τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[Rom.2.16|Rom.2:16]] τ. καρδίας, [[1Co.14.25|1Co.14:25]] τ. αἰσχύνης, [[2Co.4.2|2Co.4:2]]†
κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(κρύφα = κρυφῆ) [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, [[Jer.23.24|Jer.23:24]], al. ;]
**hidden, secret**: ἐν τῷ κ., [[Mat.6.18|Mat.6:18]]†
(AS)

G2918.def:
**κρίνον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן ;]
**a lily**: [[Mat.6.28|Mat.6:28]], [[Luk.12.27|Luk.12:27]].†
(AS)

G2917.def:
**κρίμα** (B1., § 27, 2), -τος, τό
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט ;]
the issue of a judicial process, hence,
1. **judgment, the decision passed on the faults of others**: [[Mat.7.2|Mat.7:2]] in forensic sense, with genitive pun., [[Luk.24.20|Luk.24:20]] esp. of the judgment of God, [[Rom.2.2; 5.16; 11.33|Rom.2:2 5:16 11:33]] (_ICC_, in l), [[2Pe.2.3|2Pe.2:3]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]]; κ. λαμβάνεσθαι, [[Mat.23.13|Mat.23:13]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[Mrk.12.40|Mrk.12:40]], [[Luk.20.47|Luk.20:47]], [[Rom.13.2|Rom.13:2]], [[Jas.3.1|Jas.3:1]]; ἔχειν, [[1Ti.5.12|1Ti.5:12]] βαστάζειν, [[Gal.5.10|Gal.5:10]] ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, [[1Co.11.29|1Co.11:29]] εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, [[1Co.11.34|1Co.11:34]] εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., [[Luk.23.40|Luk.23:40]] with genitive obj., [[Rom.3.8|Rom.3:8]], [[1Ti.3.6|1Ti.3:6]], [[Rev.17.1|Rev.17:1]]; of God's judgment through Christ, [[Jhn.9.39|Jhn.9:39]] τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, [[1Pe.4.17|1Pe.4:17]] τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, [[Act.24.25|Act.24:25]] κ. αἰώνιον, [[Heb.6.2|Heb.6:2]] ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τ. κ. ὐμῶν, [[Rev.18.20|Rev.18:20]] of the right of judgment, [[Rev.20.4|Rev.20:4]]
2. **a matter for judgment, a law-suit, a case**: [[1Co.6.7|1Co.6:7]]†
(AS)

G2965.def:
**κύων**, κυνός, ὁ, ἡ
(in NT masc. only), [in LXX forכֶּלֶב ;]
**a dog**: [[Luk.16.21|Luk.16:21]], [[2Pe.2.22|2Pe.2:22]]; metaphorically, as a word of reproach, [[Mat.7.6|Mat.7:6]], [[Php.3.2|Php.3:2]], [[Rev.22.15|Rev.22:15]].†
(AS)

G2925.def:
**Κρούω **
[in LXX: before ἐπί [[Jdg.19.22|Jdg.19:22]], [[Sng.5.2|Sng.5:2]] (דָּפַק) ;]
with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, [[Jdt.14.14|Jdth.14:14]] * ;]
**to strike, knock**: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), [[Mat.7.7-8|Mat.7:7-8]], [[Luk.11.9-10; 12.36|Luk.11:9-10 12:36]], [[Act.12.16|Act.12:16]], [[Rev.3.20|Rev.3:20]]; with accusative, τ. θύραν, [[Luk.13.25|Luk.13:25]], [[Act.12.13|Act.12:13]].†
(AS)

G2949.def:
**κῦμα**, -τος, τό
(κύω, to be pregnant, to swell) [in LXX chiefly for גַּל ;]
**a wave**: pl., [[Mat.8.24; 14.24|Mat.8:24 14:24]], [[Mrk.4.37|Mrk.4:37]]; κ. θαλάσσης, figuratively, [[Jude.13|Ju 13]].†
_SYN._: κλύδων, q.v (AS)

G2980.def:
**λαλέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for דּבר pi., also for אמר, etc. ;]
1. **to utter**: of inanimate things, [[Rev.4.1; 10.4|Rev.4:1 10:4]]; metaphorically, [[Heb.11.4; 12.24|Heb.11:4 12:24]].
2. **to talk, speak, say**: absol., [[Mat.9.33; 12.46|Mat.9:33 12:46]], [[Mrk.5.35|Mrk.5:35]], [[Luk.8.49|Luk.8:49]]; before ὡς, [[1Co.13.11|1Co.13:11]], [[Rev.13.11|Rev.13:11]]; εἰς, [[1Co.14.9|1Co.14:9]] ἐκ, [[Mat.12.34|Mat.12:34]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.10.19|Mat.10:19]], [[Mrk.11.32|Mrk.11:32]], [[Jhn.8.30|Jhn.8:30]], al.; with dative of person(s), [[Mat.12.46|Mat.12:46]], [[Luk.24.6|Luk.24:6]], [[Rom.7.1|Rom.7:1]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[Mat.9.18|Mat.9:18]], [[Jhn.10.6|Jhn.10:6]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, [[Mrk.6.50|Mrk.6:50]], [[Luk.1.19; 2.33|Luk.1:19 2:33]], al.; ἐν, ἐξ, ἀπό, [[Mat.13.3|Mat.13:3]], [[Jhn.12.49; 14.10|Jhn.12:49 14:10]], al.; λ. τ. λόγον, [[Mrk.8.32|Mrk.8:32]], al.; before orat. dir. (not cl.), [[Mrk.14.31|Mrk.14:31]], [[Heb.5.5; 11.18|Heb.5:5 11:18]]; Hebraistically (Dalman, _Words_, 25f.), ἐλάλησε λέγων, [[Mat.14.27|Mat.14:27]], [[Jhn.8.12|Jhn.8:12]], [[Act.8.26|Act.8:26]], al.
_SYN._: see: λέγω. (AS)

G2902.def:
**κρατέω**, -ῶ
(κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק hi., also for אָחַז, etc. ;]
1. to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: [[Est.1.1|Est.1:1]], I [[Est.4.38|Est.4:38]], [[Wis.14.19|Wis.14:19]], al.).
2. **to get possession of, obtain, take hold of **(Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive of thing(s) (M, _Pr._, 65), [[Act.27.13|Act.27:13]] τ. χειρός, [[Mat.9.25|Mat.9:25]], [[Mrk.1.31; 5.41; 9.27|Mrk.1:31 5:41 9:27]], [[Luk.8.54|Luk.8:54]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.12.11|Mat.12:11]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.14.3; 18.28; 21.46; 22.6; 26.4, 48|Mat.14:3 18:28 21:46 22:6 26:4, 48]] ff., [[Mrk.3.21; 6.17; 12.12; 14.1, 44|Mrk.3:21 6:17 12:12 14:1, 44]] ff, [[Act.3.11; 24.6|Act.3:11 24:6]], [[Rev.20.2|Rev.20:2]] (cf. [[2Sa.6.6|2Ki.6:6]]).
3. **to hold, hold fast **(Æsch., Polyb., al.): with accusative of thing(s), ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, [[Rev.2.1|Rev.2:1]] Metaphorical: with accusative of person(s), pass., [[Act.2.24|Act.2:24]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Rev.2.13, 25; 3.11|Rev.2:13, 25 3:11]]; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), [[Col.2.19|Col.2:19]] τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, [[Mrk.7.3-4, 8; 9.10|Mrk.7:3-4, 8 9:10]], [[2Th.2.15|2Th.2:15]], [[Rev.2.14-15|Rev.2:14-15]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[Heb.4.14; 6.18|Heb.4:14 6:18]]; of sins, to retain, [[Jhn.20.23|Jhn.20:23]] of re­straint, before ἵνα μή, [[Rev.7.1|Rev.7:1]] pass., before τοῦ μή, [[Luk.24.16|Luk.24:16]]†
(AS)

G2968.def:
**κώμη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for בַּת, חָצֵר, עִיר, etc. ;]
a village or country town, prop, as opposite to a walled city: [[Mat.14.15|Mat.14:15]], [[Mrk.6.6|Mrk.6:6]], al.; πόλεις καὶ κ., [[Mat.9.35|Mat.9:35]], al.; with the name added, Βηθλεέμ, [[Jhn.7.42|Jhn.7:42]] Βηθανΐα, [[Jhn.11.1|Jhn.11:1]] with the name of the district, τὰς κ. Καισαρίας, [[Mrk.8.27|Mrk.8:27]] Σαμαρειτῶν, [[Luk.9.52|Luk.9:52]], [[Act.8.25|Act.8:25]]
(AS)

G2932.def:
**κτάομαι**, -ῶμαι
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָה ;]
in pres., impf., fut. and aor., **to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire **(the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.10.9|Mat.10:9]], [[Luk.18.12|Luk.18:12]], [[Act.8.20|Act.8:20]]; with genitive pret., [[Act.22.28|Act.22:28]] ἐκ with genitive pret., [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]] τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), [[Luk.21.19|Luk.21:19]] τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι, [[1Th.4.4|1Th.4:4]] (where if σ. = body, κ. must = pf., κέκτημαι; see MM, xvi; M, _Th._, in l; Field, _Notes_, 72 f. But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., _Notes_, 53 ff.; _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G2905.def:
**κραυγάζω** (κραυγή)
[in LXX: [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]] (רוּעַ hi.)* ;] = κράζω
1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc.
2. **Of men, to cry out, shout**: [[Mat.12.19|Mat.12:19]], [[Jhn.12.13; 19.15|Jhn.12:13 19:15]] [[Act.22.23|Act.22:23]]; before λέγων, [[Jhn.18.40; 19.6, 12|Jhn.18:40 19:6, 12]]; καὶ λέγων, [[Luk.4.41|Luk.4:41]] (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[Jhn.11.43|Jhn.11:43]] (cf. Abbott, _JV_, 269 f.).†
(AS)

G2952.def:
**κυνάριον**, -ου, τό
(in Att.. also κυνίδιον, diminutive of κύων)
**a little dog**: [[Mat.15.26-27|Mat.15:26-27]] [[Mrk.7.27-28|Mrk.7:27-28]] †
(AS)

G2910.def:
**κρεμάννυμι**
(also κρεμαννύω, κρεμάω; the Pres. is not found in NT), [in LXX (where also κρεμάζω, [[Job.26.7|Job.26:7]]) chiefly for תָּלָה ;]
trans., **to hang, suspend**: with accusative of person(s), before ἐπὶ ξύλου, [[Act.5.30; 10.39|Act.5:30 10:39]]; pass., [[Luk.23.39|Luk.23:39]] before περί, [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]] Mid., κρέμαμαι, intrans., **to hang**: before ἐκ, [[Act.28.4|Act.28:4]] ἐπὶ ξύλου, [[Gal.3.13|Gal.3:13]] (LXX); metaphorically, before ἐν, [[Mat.22.40|Mat.22:40]]†
(AS)

G2936.def:
**κτίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, [[Psa.51.10|Psa.51:10]], al.; also for קָנָה, [[Gen.14.19|Gen.14:19]], [[Pro.8.22|Pro.8:22]]; יָצַר, [[Isa.22.11; 46.11|Isa.22:11 46:11]]; [[Wis.2.23|Wis.2:23]], [[Sir.1.4|Sir.1:4]], 9 (and freq.), I [[Est.4.53|Est.4:53]], a1. ;]
1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with).
2. **In LXX and NT, of God, to create**: [[Mrk.13.19|Mrk.13:19]], [[1Co.11.9|1Co.11:9]], [[Col.1.16; 3.10|Col.1:16 3:10]] [[Eph.3.9|Eph.3:9]], [[1Ti.4.3|1Ti.4:3]], [[Rev.4.11; 10.6|Rev.4:11 10:6]]; ὁ κτίσας, [[Mat.19.4|Mat.19:4]] (WH, R, mg.), [[Rom.1.25|Rom.1:25]] of the divine operation on the soul, [[Eph.2.10, 15; 4.24|Eph.2:10, 15 4:24]] (cf. Ps., l.with).†
(AS)

G2967.def:
**κωλύω**
(κόλος), [in LXX for כָּלָא, מָנַע, etc. ;]
**to hinder, re­strain, forbid, withhold**: with accusative and inf., [[Mat.19.14|Mat.19:14]], [[Luk.23.2|Luk.23:2]], [[Act.8.36; 16.6; 24.23|Act.8:36 16:6 24:23]], [[1Th.2.16|1Th.2:16]], [[Heb.7.23|Heb.7:23]]; inf. om., [[Mrk.9.38-39; 10.14|Mrk.9:38-39 10:14]], [[Luk.9.49-50; 11.52; 18.16|Luk.9:49-50 11:52 18:16]], [[Act.11.17|Act.11:17]], [[Rom.1.13|Rom.1:13]], [[3Jn.10|3Jn.10]]; accusative om., [[1Ti.4.3|1Ti.4:3]] with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), [[Act.27.43|Act.27:43]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.14.39|1Co.14:39]], [[2Pe.2.16|2Pe.2:16]]; id. before τοῦ μή, [[Act.10.47|Act.10:47]] id. before ἀπό (like _Heb._ מִן כָּלָא, [[Gen.23.6|Gen.23:6]], al.), [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]] (cf. δια-κωλύω).†
(AS)

G2933.def:
**κτῆμα**, -τος, τό
(κτάομαι), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם, etc. ;]
**a possession, property**: [[Mat.19.22|Mat.19:22]], [[Mrk.10.22|Mrk.10:22]], [[Act.2.45; 5.1|Act.2:45 5:1]].†
(AS)

G2985.def:
**λαμπάς**, -άδος, ἡ
(λάμπω), [in LXX for לַפִּיד ;]
**a torch **(frequently fed, like a lamp, with oil): [[Mat.25.1|Mat.25:1]] ff., [[Jhn.18.3|Jhn.18:3]], [[Act.20.8|Act.20:8]], [[Rev.4.5; 8.10|Rev.4:5 8:10]].†
(AS)

G2906.def:
**κραυγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc. ;]
**crying, outcry, clamour**: [[Mat.25.6|Mat.25:6]], [[Luk.1.42|Luk.1:42]], [[Act.23.9|Act.23:9]], [[Eph.4.31|Eph.4:31]], [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]], [[Rev.21.4|Rev.21:4]].†
(AS)

G2981.def:
**λαλία**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, דִּבְרָה ;]
1. loquacity = Very talkative.
2. **talk, speech, conversation**: [[Mat.26.73|Mat.26:73]] (cf. Ca 43), [[Jhn.4.42; 8.43|Jhn.4:42 8:43]].†
(AS)

G2982.def:
**λαμά** (Heb. מָה, seel. λεμά = Aram. לְמָא)
**why**: [[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]] (WH, mg., λεμά TTr., WH, txt., λεμά L), [[Mrk.15.34|Mrk.15:34]] (λεμά LT, λαμμᾶ, Rec.).†
(AS)

G2998.def:
**λατομέω**, -ῶ
(λατόμος, a stonecutter, [[2Ki.12.12|4Ki.12:12]], al.; λᾶς, τέμνω; cf. λαξευτός) [in LXX: [[1Ch.22.2|1Ch.22:2]], al. (חָצַב); [[Exo.21.33|Exo.21:33]], Num_21:18 (כָּרָה) ;]
**to hew, hew out stones**: [[Mat.27.60|Mat.27:60]], [[Mrk.15.46|Mrk.15:46]].†
(AS)

G2955.def:
**κύπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַד ;]
**to bow the head, stoop down**: [[Mrk.1.7|Mrk.1:7]] before κάτω, [[Jhn.8.6|Jhn.8:6]], 8 (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-, συν-κύπτω).†
κατα-κύπτω,
[in LXX: [[2Ki.9.32|4Ki.9:32]] (שָׁקַף hi.)* ;]
**to bend down, stoop**: [[Jhn.8.8|Jhn.8:8]] (κάτω κύψας, Rec., WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G2969.def:
**κωμόπολις**, -εως, ἡ
**a country town**: [[Mrk.1.38|Mrk.1:38]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G2945.def:
**κύκλος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;]
a ring, circle. Dat., κύκλῳ, as adverb., **round about, around**: [[Mrk.3.34; 6.6, 36|Mrk.3:34 6:6, 36]], [[Luk.9.12|Luk.9:12]], [[Rom.15.19|Rom.15:19]]; with genitive, [[Rev.4.6; 5.11; 7.11|Rev.4:6 5:11 7:11]]†
(AS)

G2990.def:
**λανθάνω **
[in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc. ;]
**to escape notice, be hidden **(from): [[Mrk.7.24|Mrk.7:24]], [[Luk.8.47|Luk.8:47]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Act.26.26|Act.26:26]], [[2Pe.3.5; 3.8|2Pe.3:5 3:8]]; as in common cl. idiom, before ptcp., ἔλαθον ξενίσαντες, entertained unawares, [[Heb.13.2|Heb.13:2]] (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-λανθάνω).†
(AS)

G2947.def:
**κυλίω ** late form of κυλίνδω,
[in LXX: [[Jos.10.18|Jos.10:18]], [[1Sa.14.33|1Ki.14:33]], al. (גָּלַל), [[2Ki.9.33|4Ki.9:33]] (שָׁמַט), al. ;]
to roll, roll along. Pass., to be rolled; of persons (in Hom, as sign of grief), **to roll or wallow**: [[Mrk.9.20|Mrk.9:20]]†
(AS)

G2937.def:
**κτίσις**, -εως, ἡ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: [[Psa.104.24|Psa.104:24]] (קִנְיָן), [[Pro.1.13|Pro.1:13]] A (הוֹן), [[Tob.8.5|Tob.8:5]], [[Wis.2.6|Wis.2:6]], [[Sir.16.17|Sir.16:17]], [[3Ma.2.2|3Ma.2:2]], al. ;]
1. a founding, settling, foundation (cl.).
2. In LXX and NT,
(a) **the act of creating, creation**: [[Mrk.10.6|Mrk.10:6]] (Swete, in l), [[Mrk.13.19|Mrk.13:19]], [[Rom.1.20|Rom.1:20]], [[2Pe.3.4|2Pe.3:4]];
(b) **that which has been created, creation**: [[Rom.1.25; 8.39|Rom.1:25 8:39]], [[Heb.4.13|Heb.4:13]]; καινὴ κ., [[2Co.5.17|2Co.5:17]], [[Gal.6.15|Gal.6:15]]; πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κ. (Hort., in l), [[1Pe.2.13|1Pe.2:13]] collectively, of the sum of created things ([[Wis.19.6|Wis.19:6]], [[Jdt.16.14|Jdth.16:14]]), [[Mrk.16.15|Mrk.16:15]], [[Col.1.15, 23|Col.1:15, 23]] [[Heb.9.11|Heb.9:11]], [[Rev.3.14|Rev.3:14]]; of the irrational creation, [[Rom.8.19-22|Rom.8:19-22]]†
(AS)

G2903.def:
**κράτιστος**, -η, -ον
superl, of κρατύς (Hom.),
1. strongest, mightiest (Hom.).
2. noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), **most excellent **(find., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (_DCG_, ii, 727a), [[Luk.1.3|Luk.1:3]], [[Act.23.26; 24.3; 26.25|Act.23:26 24:3 26:25]].†
(AS)

G2975.def:
**λαγχάνω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.14.47|1Ki.14:47]] (לָכַד, see _Th._, _Gr._, 38), [[Wis.8.19|Wis.8:19]], 3Mac 61 * ;]
1. **to obtain by lot, to obtain **(in cl., with genitive): with inf. art. (B1., § 36, 3; 71, 3), [[Luk.1.9|Luk.1:9]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.1.17|Act.1:17]], [[2Pe.1.1|2Pe.1:1]].
2. **to draw lots**: before περί, [[Jhn.19.24|Jhn.19:24]]
(AS)

G2904.def:
**κράτος**, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX chiefly for עֹז, [[Job.12.16|Job.12:16]], [[Psa.90.11|Psa.90:11]] al. ;]
1. strength, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength.
2. **power, might**: [[Heb.2.14|Heb.2:14]] τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, [[Eph.1.19; 6.10|Eph.1:19 6:10]] ([[Isa.40.26|Isa.40:26]], Da TH [[Dan.4.27|Dan.4:27]]); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, [[Col.1.11|Col.1:11]] κατὰ κράτος, mightily, [[Act.19.20|Act.19:20]] a mighty deed, an act of power, [[Luk.1.51|Luk.1:51]] in doxologies, [[1Ti.6.16|1Ti.6:16]], [[1Pe.4.11; 5.11|1Pe.4:11 5:11]], [[Jude.25|Ju 25]], [[Rev.1.6; 5.13|Rev.1:6 5:13]].†
(AS)

G2901.def:
**κραταιόω**, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
**to strengthen**; pass., **to wax strong**: [[Luk.2.40|Luk.2:40]], [[1Co.16.13|1Co.16:13]]; πνεύματι, [[Luk.1.80|Luk.1:80]] δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, [[Eph.3.16|Eph.3:16]]†
(AS)

G2958.def:
**Κυρήνιος**
(prop. -ίνιος, see Bl., 13; -ῖνος L, -εῖνος, Tr., WH, mg.), -ου, ὁ,
Quirinus, prop. Quirinius: [[Luk.2.2|Luk.2:2]]†
(AS)

G2934.def:
**κτῆνος**, -ους, τό
(κτάομαι, hence primarily a possession), [in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה [[Gen.1.25|Gen.1:25]], al., also for מִקְנֶה, צֹנֵא, etc. ;]
a beast, (in late Gk. esp.) a beast of burden: [[Luk.10.34|Luk.10:34]] pl. (as chiefly in cl.), [[Act.23.24|Act.23:24]], [[Rev.18.13|Rev.18:13]]; of quadrupeds, as Opp. to fishes and birds (cf. Ge, l.with), [[1Co.15.39|1Co.15:39]]†
(AS)

G2926.def:
**κρύπτη** (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ,
**a crypt, cellar**: [[Luk.11.33|Luk.11:33]]†
(AS)

G2988.def:
**λαμπρῶς **
_adv._,
**splendidly**: of sumptuous fare (as freq.; cf. ἐδέσματα λαμπρά, [[Sir.29.22|Sir.29:22]]), [[Luk.16.19|Luk.16:19]].†
(AS)

G2976.def:
**Λάζαρος**, -ου, ὁ
colloquial abbreviation of Ἐλεαζάρ (άζαρος), which see),
**Lazarus**;
1. **of Bethany**: [[Jhn.11.1|Jhn.11:1]] ff. [[Jhn.12.1-2, 9-10; 12.17|Jhn.12:1-2, 9-10 12:17]].
2. **The beggar in the parable**: [[Luk.16.20, 23-25|Luk.16:20, 23-25]].†
(AS)

G2944.def:
**κυκλόω**, -ῶ
(κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
1. to move in a circle, revolve.
2. **to surround, encircle**: with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.10.24|Jhn.10:24]] (WH, txt., cf. -εύω), [[Act.14.20|Act.14:20]] pass., [[Luk.21.20|Luk.21:20]], [[Heb.11.30|Heb.11:30]] (cf. περι-κυκλόω).†
(AS)

G2961.def:
**κυριεύω**
(κύριος), [in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁל ;]
**to be lord or master of, to rule **(over): C. genitive obj., [[Luk.22.25|Luk.22:25]], [[Rom.14.9|Rom.14:9]], [[2Co.1.24|2Co.1:24]]; absol., [[1Ti.6.15|1Ti.6:15]] metaphorically, ὁ θάνατος, [[Rom.6.9|Rom.6:9]] ἡ ἁμαρτία, [[Rom.6.14|Rom.6:14]] ὁ νόμος, [[Rom.7.1|Rom.7:1]] (cf. κατα-κυριεύω).†
(AS)

G2991.def:
**λαξευτός**, -ή, όν
(λαξεύω; λᾶς, a stone, ξέω, to scrape), [in LXX: [[Deu.4.49|Deu.4:49]] (פִּסְגָּה); in Aq.: [[Num.21.20|Num.21:20]] _Th._: [[Jdg.7.11|Jdg.7:11]] * ;]
**hewn **(in stone); [[Luk.23.53|Luk.23:53]] (elsewhere κοινή writers use λατομητός, [[2Ki.12.12|4Ki.12:12]], al.; cf. λατομέω).†
(AS)

G2999.def:
**λατρεία**, -ας, ἡ
(λατρεύω, which see), [in LXX (always of divine service): [[Exo.12.25-26; 13.5|Exo.12:25-26 13:5]], [[Jos.22.27|Jos.22:27]], [[1Ch.28.13|1Ch.28:13]] (עֲבֹדָה), [[1Ma.1.43|1Ma.1:43]] [[1Mac.2.19|1Mac 2:19]] [[1Mac.2.22|1Mac 2:22]], [[3Ma.4.14|3Ma.4:14]] * ;]
1. hired service, service.
2. (in cl. also) divine service, **worship**: [[Jhn.16.2|Jhn.16:2]], [[Rom.9.4; 12.1|Rom.9:4 12:1]], [[Heb.9.1|Heb.9:1]], 6.†
(AS)

G2997.def:
**λάσκω **
1. (in cl., poët.) to clang, crash, crack; in late prose, **to crack or burst noisily**: [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]] (ἐλάκησεν, perh., however, from λακέω, which see; Bl., in l).
2. (in cl., prose) to scream, shout.†
λακέω, Dor. for ληκέω = λάσκω, q.v
(AS)

G2972.def:
**Κῶς ** genitive Κῶ, ἡ,
**Cos, an island in the Ægean Sea**: accusative Κῶ, [[Act.21.1|Act.21:1]] (Κῶν, Rec.).†
(AS)

G2987.def:
**λαμπρότης**, -ητος, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Psa.110.3|Psa.110:3]] (הָדָר), al. ;]
**brightness, brilliancy**: τ. ἡλίου, [[Act.26.13|Act.26:13]]†
(AS)

G2996.def:
**Λασέα (Rec. -αία), -ας, ἡ **
**Lasea, a city of Crete, otherwise un­known**: [[Act.27.8|Act.27:8]]†
(AS)

G2942.def:
**κυβερνήτης**, -ου, ὁ
(see: κυβέρνησις), [in LXX for חֹבֵל, [[Ezk.27.8, 27-28|Eze.27:8, 27-28]], [[Pro.23.24|Pro.23:24]], [[4Ma.7.1|4Ma.7:1]] * ;]
1. **a steersman, pilot**: [[Act.27.11|Act.27:11]], [[Rev.18.17|Rev.18:17]].
2. Metaphorical, a guide, governor (Eur., Plat.).†
(AS)

G2995.def:
**λάρυγξ**, -γγος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֵךְ, [[Job.6.30|Job.6:30]], al; [[Psa.5.9|Psa.5:9]] (גָּרוֹן) ;]
**the larynx, throat**: metaphorically, of speech (cf. [[Sir.6.5|Sir.6:5]]), [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G2907.def:
**κρέας**, -έως, pl., κρέα
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;]
**flesh, meat**: [[Rom.14.21|Rom.14:21]], [[1Co.8.13|1Co.8:13]].†
(AS)

G2922.def:
**κριτήριον**, -ου, τό
(κριτής), [in LXX: [[1Ki.7.7|3Ki.7:7]] (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH [[Dan.7.10, 26|Dan.7:10, 26]], (דִּין), [[Sus.1.49|Su 1:49]], [[Exo.21.6|Exo.21:6]], [[Jdg.5.10|Jdg.5:10]] * ;]
1. a means of judging, test, criterion.
2. **a tribunal**: [[1Co.6.2; 6.4|1Co.6:2 6:4]], [[Jas.2.6|Jas.2:6]].†
(AS)

G2960.def:
**κυριακός**, -ή, -όν
(κύριος), [in LXX: κ. φωνη (Συριακή φ., R), [[2Ma.15.36|2Ma.15:36]] A * ;]
1. as frequently in Inscr. (LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 217 f.), of the lord or master, imperial.
